label: Global header — logo, 4 top-level links each with a second-level dropdown, search toggle, mobile hamburger drawer
notes: Two-level nav. Desktop = hover/click dropdowns; mobile = separate #ppm-nav-mobile-* UL tree with accordion behaviour. Search opens an inline panel (#search-container). Sourced from an AEM Experience Fragment, so in EDS this belongs in /nav document, not the page.

label: Hero — full-bleed image with overlaid white title card, H1 + sky-blue underline rule
semantic_signal: class="cmp-hero" with __content (h1) + __image children; first section under <main>, single non-repeating slide
notes: No body copy or CTA in this instance — title only. White card is left-offset and vertically centred over the image; on mobile the card stacks below the image. Accent rule uses #5BC2E7.

label: Intro statement — 33/66 two-column text: bold left heading, right paragraph
semantic_signal: class fragment cmp-container-columns-33-66; two .cmp-text children, no repetition, no interactivity
notes: AMBIGUOUS. Content-wise this is one heading + one paragraph, which the taxonomy says is NOT a component. But the 33/66 side-by-side layout can't be expressed in EDS default content flow, so it needs the columns block. Recommend keeping it as a columns entry; drop it only if you'd rather stack heading-over-paragraph and lose the split layout. Stacks to single column below 900px.
resolution: CONFIRMED (default applied, not explicitly answered): keep as columns block to preserve the 33/66 split. Reuses boilerplate columns block.

label: Firm statistics band — teal panel; row of 4 big stats, horizontal rule, then a labelled row of 4 more stats
semantic_signal: 8 repeated .cmp-numbertext siblings (prestat icon + number + poststat icon + stat label) in two cmp-container-columns-4-equal groups, split by .cmp-separator
notes: No taxonomy type fits — it is a stat/metric band, not a card-grid (no images, no links) and not a cta-banner (no button). Proposing a NEW 'stats' block. Two internal variants: (a) plain 4-up row, (b) row preceded by a left-hand label 'OUR INVESTMENT PROFESSIONALS:' at 33/66. Numbers support a prefix ($) and suffix (%) glyph and a footnote <sup>. Teal #004F59, serif CenturyStd numerals at 112px desktop. Full-width bleed. Stacks 1-up on mobile.
resolution: CONFIRMED by user: build a NEW "stats" block. Must support number + label rows, $ prefix / % suffix glyphs, footnote <sup>, an optional left-hand row label, a divider between groups, and the full-bleed teal theme.

label: Our Insights — section title + 3-up grid of linked cards (image, eyebrow, title)
semantic_signal: 3 similarly-shaped .staticcard/.cmp-card siblings in cmp-container-columns-3-equal, each an <a> wrapping image + pretitle + title
notes: Whole card is a single link. Card body = eyebrow ('CIO Letter' / 'Quarterly Insights') + bold uppercase title. No description or explicit CTA on this instance. Section heading 'Our Insights' is serif. 3-up desktop, 1-up mobile.

label: Our Advantage — gray band, image left / heading + bullet list + green CTA button right
semantic_signal: single .cmp-card with modifier .cmp-card--left; __image + __content-wrapper (pre-title, description, action-container with one button)
notes: Sits between cta-banner and a media-and-text 'feature' block. It has one prominent action ('OUR STORY', #008578) which argues cta-banner, but also a 50/50 image split and a bulleted body, which a plain cta-banner block usually will not carry. Confirm whether to treat this as a cta-banner variant or its own feature/media block. Image is flush to the left page edge (breaks the container gutter). Stacks image-over-text on mobile.
resolution: CONFIRMED by user: build a NEW "feature" media+text block. Image one side / rich text (heading, bullet list, CTA button) the other; left-right side option; gray or white theme; image flush to page edge.

label: Legal disclaimer — two fine-print paragraphs on a gray band
semantic_signal: two .cmp-text paragraphs, no repetition, no interactivity
notes: Proposed as NOT a component per taxonomy ('a single heading + paragraph ... stays as plain content'). In EDS this is default content in a section with a style like 'disclaimer' (small type, gray background) applied via Section Metadata. Listed here only so you can veto the exclusion.
resolution: CONFIRMED by user, OVERRIDING the proposed exclusion: build a NEW small "disclaimer" block so the fine-print styling is enforced by the block rather than a section style.

label: Global footer — logo, address list, LinkedIn icon; second row with copyright and policy links
notes: Two rows. Address is a <ul> rendered inline (street, suite, city, phone). Policy links: Contact Us, Privacy Policy, Terms and Conditions, Social. Sourced from an Experience Fragment, so in EDS this belongs in the /footer document.
